messages:
jules: Quick idea: collapse Models + Pipelines into a single 'Workloads' group to free vertical space for breadcrumbs + quick-actions. Prototype in figma. Reactions?

maria: Happy to reduce clutter. Main worry is breaking people's muscle memory and docs that link /models/. Need a redirect plan.

sam: Agree. Keep canonical `/app/:org/workloads/:kind/:id`. Add server 301s and client router.replace to `/workloads/...` so history isn't noisy.

anya: Breadcrumb UX: prefer 'Org > Workloads > Models > Short title'. Truncate long names with ellipsis, show full on hover. Provide a copy-link action on the last crumb.

jules: For deep-link behavior: route should expand the collapsed group, animate open (~180ms), focus the row, but avoid auto-scrolling the main content. Also announce expansion with aria-live polite.

sam: Tiny middleware sketch:
```
if (path.startsWith(`/app/${org}/models/`)) {
  router.replace(path.replace('/models/', '/workloads/models/'))
}
```
Also mark telemetry `redirect.legacy_models`.

anya: A11y checklist highlights: focus lands on the item, visible focus ring, skip-to-content when rail is compact, aria-current on final crumb. Test VoiceOver + NVDA.

maria: Search implications: pin 'Models' type to Cmd+K results and surface an open-group action. Docs: I'll list all legacy paths and add curl examples for QA.

jules: OK good path. Action items: @sam implement redirects + tests, @anya write a11y checklist, @maria update docs and search pin, I'll iterate prototype animation. dev-ops-bot: reminder to add this to the Friday design review doc.
